chunks: 1830 - Hariz narrated from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام: What do you say regarding the night of the middle of Shaʿban?

He عليه السلام said: “On it, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, forgives from His creation more than the number of the hairs of the goats of Kalb, and Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sends down His angels to the lowest heaven and to the earth at Makkah.”
And I have presented what I narrated on this meaning in the book Fada'il Shaʿban.

key_terms.السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا: the lowest heaven; the nearest heaven to the earthly realm
key_terms.خَلْقِهِ: His creation; the creatures whom Allah forgives
key_terms.شَعْبَانَ: Shaʿban, the lunar month in which this blessed night occurs
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ النِّصْفِ: the night of the middle; referring here to the middle night of Shaʿban
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah; the earthly location specifically mentioned in the narration
key_terms.مَلَائِكَتَهُ: His angels; the angels sent down by Allah
key_terms.يَغْفِرُ: forgives; Allah’s pardoning of His creation on this night

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about the virtue of the night of mid-Shaʿban?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of the virtue of the night of the middle of Shaʿban, describing it as a night of immense divine forgiveness. It also mentions the descent of the angels to the lowest heaven and to the earth at Makkah, indicating the special rank and blessedness of that night.
